what_this_is: PTF-TOLEDO-OH-NEW-MARKET-001 market-local OSM extract registry. Passed to osm_extract_cli.py with --registry so the shared registry stays untouched while Fort Wayne and Lexington run concurrently.
provenance: Geofabrik publishes per-state extracts of OpenStreetMap under the ODbL at https://download.geofabrik.de/north-america/us.html; each *.osm.pbf has a sibling *.osm.pbf.md5. Attribution: (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.

extracts.notes: PTF-TOLEDO-OH-NEW-MARKET-001 market-local registry row. Identical extract (same URL, same md5 e85cdb27eba19b7239c1a8f943081d72) as the committed geofabrik-ohio row; only the index_path and markets list differ, because the committed Cleveland index was reduced to the Cleveland bbox (min_lng -82.05) and does not contain a single Toledo element (Toledo sits at -83.54). This file is market-local and is NOT the shared registry: scripts/pettripfinder/discovery/config/osm_extracts.json is unmodified by this order.
